first slice on issue/1449-predrilled-entry · PR #1493 (Refs, not Fixes - this issue stays open) · pinned by app `predrilled_entry` (a_drilled_hole_ahead_is_plunged_to_full_depth_and_posted, deleting_the_drill_takes_the_plunge_away, a_drill_no_wider_than_the_tool_plus_clearance_is_refused_by_name, a_shallow_hole_serves_only_the_levels_it_reaches, the_flag_is_an_undoable_edit_and_refused_off_the_pocket, mcp_sets_and_undoes_the_flag), motion `predrilled_entry`, unit `predrilled_entry_tests` · merges at the next cut (feat)

What the slice covers:
- 2D Pocket only, with `links.approach.predrilled`.
- The holes come from the Drill operations ahead of the pocket in the same setup.
- A hole is used only when both hold:
  - the drill is at least the tool's diameter plus 0.1 mm a side;
  - the prior stock grid shows it open under the tool disc to the level's Z (the counted depth is the deeper of the grid reading and the drill point's cone).
- The plan is re-seated on the hole.
- Every other case keeps the asked entry and says why by name.

Still owed here (not in #1493):
- The UI "Entry positions (pre-drilled)" group and its structural test.
- 2D Adaptive, Slot and the 3D roughing kinds (refused at the door for now).
- Holes in the model, typed points with the explicit "the hole exists" choice, carried stock from a previous setup, and the "pre-drilled only" mode.
- Non-centre-cutting tools down a hole (needs the proved holes fed to `plunge_law`).
- A user-set clearance.
- A golden CL file.
- The setup-sheet mention.
